claims.fact: MSSM N=1 matter and both Hu,Hd retained; add one adjoint chiral Aj for each Gi=SU3,SU2,U1. Each Aj contains complex scalar and independent LH Weyl, with exact weights SU3 adjoint[1,1],SU2 adjoint[2],U1 adjoint singlet. Therefore complex neutral real-type Aj scalar gives two real-module copies; fermion gives one Weyl. MSSM adjoint gaugino already counted, so Dirac gauginos are not additional fermions on top of both Weyl constituents.

Source explicitly defines renormalizable effective theory with soft breaking and external W'alpha/M=theta_alpha mD spurion. Accepted visible EFT has dynamical gSM only; background hidden U1 connection/unknown hidden matter is not appended as an incompletely specified gauge factor. No bulk/brane or unified regime is summed into this 4D EFT.
One chiral pair (3,2,-5/6)+(bar3,2,5/6) beyond MSSM+Aj; each contains complex scalar and LH Weyl.

limitations: Visible gSM EFT only, with hidden W'alpha/M external spurion. Supersymmetry-breaking hidden/UV completion and GUT-breaking Higgs sector are not part of, or claimed by, this regime. Existing historical hidden-sector/alternate-regime assertions remain provenance.
